Human-readable document title that may be displayed in search results etc. This may be documentType’s display name, or it may contain further information. Example: ‘Patient summary of Jane Green 10.12.2024’.
Document legal authentication details.
The person or organisation taking responsibility for the content of the document.
Date and time when the document was authenticated.

Categorisation of the event covered by the document (e.g. in the case of a partial patient summary related to a specific context). A narrative easy-to-read representation of the full dataset, e.g. PDF version of a document.
